name: Particle Cards
description: Row of image cards drawn as thousands of colored canvas particles. Hovering a card swaps its image to a second one, revealed under the cursor through a particle brush, with a slide-in intro.
contents: Cards with a particle canvas image and an overlapping large label
Full-screen loading overlay shown until images are ready
behavior: Each card renders its image as moving particles sampled from the image pixels
On hover, particles within the mouse range switch to colors of the hover image
Cards and labels slide in with a GSAP timeline once all images load
Card size shrinks on narrow screens and cards wrap into rows
editableByProps: Cards, labels, default and hover images
Card size, spacing, particle count, particle size and hover brush radius
Background, label and loader colors, label font and size
Intro animation delay, duration and stagger

needsCodeEdit.where: The Loading... paragraph at the end of the ParticleCards return
Particle class drawShape method and ParticlesCollection particlesConfig defaults

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Loads the Red Rose Google font by adding a link to document head
Loading overlay is fixed over the whole viewport until images load
Images must allow cross-origin fetching, they are read through XMLHttpRequest for pixel sampling
Card width is capped to the viewport width minus 96px on small screens
